art_direction: 半轮橙日和一条靛蓝弯带围绕中心留白，米灰底，像极简日落符号。
composition: one original focal subject, centered and readable within a circular avatar crop
creative_direction: Create an abstract sunset sign using a burnt-orange half-disc and one indigo curved band below it. Offset the half-disc slightly left while the band rises at the right, creating a gentle directional tension. Leave a broad strip of background between the two forms. Use a pale gray-beige field and perfectly flat pigment, with no horizon scenery or literal water reflections. Keep the band ends rounded but unequal. The composition should work as a compact emblem without becoming a logo or containing letters. Create a square 1024x1024 avatar with a clear central silhouette that remains legible at thumbnail size. Use an original text-only composition, without lettering, logos, signatures, or watermarks.
style_inspiration: Original artwork from written art direction; prior conversation informs general design preferences, no prior image pixels reused or uploaded.
visual_review: passed: compressed preview inspected for clear original focal composition, requested medium and detail level, circular-crop readability, no unintended anatomy or rendering defects, no text or watermark
